# Care Membrane MCP

> AI Safety evaluation toolkit: care scoring, threat detection, burnout analysis, relationship pred...

`care-membrane-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install care-membrane-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx care-membrane-mcp
```

## Tools

- `validate_care` — Validate text against care-centered principles. Returns care score (0-100),
- `detect_threats` — Detect security threats, jailbreak attempts, prompt injection, PII extraction,
- `analyze_care_patterns` — Analyze care patterns to detect burnout risk and relationship health imbalances.
- `predict_relationship_evolution` — Predict how a relationship will evolve over the next 30 days based on
- `evaluate_care_membrane` — Evaluate an LLM response against the 16-probe Care Membrane framework.
- `get_care_probes` — List all 16 Care Membrane probes with their categories and expected behaviors.
- `predict_risk_neural` — Neural network-based risk prediction that improves from every compliance check.
- `neural_insights` — Get aggregate learning insights from the neural compliance model.
- `quick_check` — Paste any AI response and get an instant care score + threat detection. No API key needed.
- `what_is_care_membrane` — Explains the 16-probe Care Membrane framework and care ethics approach. No parameters needed.
